proposed_expansion_criteria.death_clarity: At least 80% of sampled deaths correctly explained without coaching; report numerator and denominator.
proposed_expansion_criteria.voluntary_rematches: A majority independently willing to rematch in each follow-up group; distinguish requested rounds from voluntary requests.
proposed_expansion_criteria.emergence: At least two distinct emergent causal patterns recurring across rounds.
proposed_expansion_criteria.stability: No unresolved session-blocking/control failures; recurring high-impact issues addressed with regression and human follow-up evidence. Small samples are product evidence, not statistical proof.
